none: PAS NLM-3EE81E: Roman Coin: Radiate of Carausius
contea di ritrovamento: North Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Copper alloy coin. Radiate of Carausius (286-293), (Reece period 14), COMES AVG, Minerva standng left Mint of London, B E // MLXXI. RIC V, pt 2, p. 464, no. 13. This coin is included in Sam Moorhead's corpus for RIC. Obverse description: Bullnecked radiate bust draped and cuirassed right. Obverse inscription: IMP CARAVSIVS PF AVG. Diameter: 25.1mm, Weight: 3.04gms, die axis: 6
